entries.title: Ordinary footage, impossible event: a useful mismatch
entries.title_zh: 日常影像与不可能事件：值得研究的偏差
entries.author: cocktailpeanut
entries.retrieval_method: Public X post text and media metadata via api.fxtwitter.com; direct X web requests returned HTTP 403.
entries.prompt_excerpt: A hyper-realistic handheld phone video of a quiet suburban backyard on a bright normal afternoon.
entries.prompt_status: Short verbatim excerpt; complete author prompt is linked at prompt_url.
entries.mode: Author reports local Windows generation and a 14-second clip.
entries.mode_zh: 作者自述在 Windows 本地生成，片段约 14 秒。
entries.lesson: The brief delays its impossible event behind ordinary activity. This is useful for studying setup and surprise, alongside whether H3 follows the requested physical event.
entries.lesson_zh: 通过日常活动铺垫再引出不可能事件，适合研究伏笔、突变，以及模型是否按指定物理事件执行。
entries.review: Important mismatch: sampled output shows a residential street and a large advancing cloud, rather than the requested backyard and a rigid falling sky. Included as a prompt-adherence study.
entries.review_zh: 明显偏差：抽帧显示住宅街道与逼近的巨大云墙，并非原文要求的后院及整体下坠的固体天空；作为提示词遵循度案例收录。
